note: Re-judged 2026-10-11 by an independent judge after the row was widened to the R item head. Whole sentence 'This bit MUST be cleared in all request messages and MUST be set in all responses' (RFC 7296 3.1). TestResponseBitMatchesDirection compares the R bit for equality with isResponse on every engine-built message, so a request with R set or a response with R clear fails. TestRFC7296InitiatorIgnoresAResponseWithTheRBitClear feeds handleInbound the responder's real IKE_SA_INIT answer with only the R bit cleared (state stays sa-init-sent), then the untouched answer (advances): isolation by a one-bit difference. Revert records on buildSAInitResponse and handleInbound are reach proofs only.
